Introduction
This document outlines the 
 equipment inspection I2, which must be performed every six months as indicated by 
 M6 in the title block.
The first draft is 
 initiated by eng Abdulatif Ahmed, tested by eng. Mahmoud Ahmed El-bassiuny, 
 reviewed by eng. Fahmy Fathy Abd El-Khalek, accepted by general manager eng Fawzy Sayed Ahmed, approved by 
 eng Farouk Awad Ali head sector of Talkha PS, and revised by quality control 
 eng Adel Abd Elkader El Nagar.
This document certified by 
 eng Samir Abd El Gilil MDEPC
 inspection & quality control general manager 
 MPIS coordinator, and 
 accepted by accountant 
 Mohamed Naguib
 MDEPC inspection and quality 
 control head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
No smoking is permitted in battery room.
Use standard personal safety equipments .
Water source must be available in battery room.
Tools 
and Equipment
Hydrometer.
Digital multimeter .
Thermometer.
Complete set of common keys.
Work to be 
carried out
Make sure the cell are clean and dry , externally clean the 
 caps .
Check that connections are properly tightened , lubricate them 
 and fully screw them
Check the temp of the cell : constantly high temp will 
 increase the consumption of the water and reduce the life of the battery 
 whereas, constantly low temp will lower discharge performance.
Read the voltage, density and temp of each cell
Check electrolyte level and top them up with distilled water 
 if necessary
Apply an equalizing charge
